question: What exalted status is attained through mere knowledge of this teaching?
premises: Mere knowledge is stated as the sufficient means.
The result is becoming lord of all perfections.
The attainment is expressed as a potential outcome.
inference: By mere knowledge of this, one would become the lord of all perfections.
uncertainties: yasya may refer to the guru, the teaching, or the knowledge itself.
plain_english: By mere knowledge of whom, one would become the lord of all perfections.
